DRIVEN TO ZERO. agromarin d6029c68b replaced the seven %r placeholders in translated messages (five in geoengine/models/geo_domain.py, one each in document_compliance/models/document_type.py and account_move_name_sequence/models/account_journal.py) with %s inside explicit quotes, and rewrote the matching msgids in the three modules' catalogues so no translation goes fuzzy. Measured 0 with py_lint.py agromarin --count from an odoo worktree laid out beside a clean detached agromarin worktree of that commit, as the sibling lane lays it out. Kept as a file rather than deleted: the note is the record of the seven.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

RE-STAMPED AFTER THE agromarin REBASE, NUMBER UNCHANGED. agromarin replayed onto origin on 2026-09-04, so every SHA in it changed and the stamps written earlier the same day were orphaned within the hour. Re-measured at c7964a30e in a clean detached worktree laid out beside a clean odoo worktree, as that lane lays it out, and it reads what the floor already said. This stamp names a agromarin commit, so an odoo rebase does not orphan it again.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMP REFRESHED, NUMBER UNCHANGED. The old stamp named a commit the 2026-09-02 sync replayed away, so --list flagged it ORPHANED-BASE and agromarin's architecture.yml exited 2 asking to be re-measured rather than comparing. Re-measured with 'py_lint.py agromarin --count' in a clean detached worktree of agromarin at 5c9d04d76, laid out beside a clean odoo worktree exactly as that lane lays it out, and it reads what the floor already said.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMPED, NOT MOVED. The floor carried no `measured_at` at all, so it was a number nobody could reproduce: the guard that refuses a stamp this branch never had cannot fire on a floor with no stamp, and an unstamped floor may never have been true of any tree. Re-measured on a clean detached worktree at the stamped commit -- python odoo/tooling/lint/py_lint.py agromarin --count -- and it reads 6, equal to the floor. The count does not move; only the stamp does. A sibling floor's stamp is the SIBLING's commit, recorded through `--update --root agromarin` from a clean detached worktree of that checkout, so it resolves in the repository that was actually measured.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

First baseline for this scope. `lint_case.is_core_path` scoped every test_lint gate to the community fork, so this repository's Python was checked by nothing at all; `tooling/lint/py_lint.py` runs the same checkers over any roots and its own CI now holds them here.

The floor lives in the community fork because that is where the gate and every other floor live, scoped by provenance so a run judges only this repository's count. `--mode no-increase`, as the other cross-repo ratchets: an exact floor across a repository boundary would make every fix here red until a matching commit in `odoo` banked it. Growth still fails, and lowering is done by hand from a workspace holding all four checkouts.

Measured 2026-08-25 with `py_lint.py <repo> --count`, under exactly the corpus rules the in-odoo gate applies -- verified by pointing the same tool at `odoo addons`, where it reports every number `ratchet.py --list` holds.
